title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
"I've had a couple of episodes of low blood sugar this week."

History of Present Illness
The patient presents for follow-up regarding management of his type 2 diabetes. He reports two episodes of mild hypoglycemia over the past week. He takes both insulin and metformin daily for his type 2 diabetes mellitus. He notes that the symptoms were mild and resolved quickly with a snack.

Medication List
Insulin (dose and frequency not specified)
Metformin

Physical Exam
Vitals are stable. General exam is unremarkable. Extremities are warm and well-perfused.

Assessment
1. Type 2 diabetes mellitus.
2. History of hypoglycemia.

Plan
Continue current regimen of insulin and metformin for management of type 2 diabetes. Instructed patient on signs and symptoms of hypoglycemia and when to treat. Follow up in three months.
explanations: Diabetes with hypoglycemia and no coma documented: E11.649.
When both insulin and oral hypoglycemics are used, assign both Z79.4 and Z79.84.

distractors.why: Hypoglycemia is a complication with its own code.
Both Z codes are assigned when both drug types are used.
